faults.title: Dashboard rattles (Mk3)
faults.description: Owners of the 2013-2018 Mk3 report rattles, creaks and squeaks from the dash, mainly around the centre console.

faults.title: Rattling seatbelt height adjusters (early Mk3)
faults.description: On earlier Mk3 cars, the seatbelt height adjusters in the A-pillars tend to rattle loudly. Later cars got a redesigned part.

faults.title: Mk3 recalls: oil leaks, driveshafts, fuel
faults.description: Mk3 recalls covered airbags, engine oil leaks, loss of drive from faulty driveshafts, possible engine failure from a manufacturing fault and fuel leaks that could lead to fire.

faults.title: Crankshaft recall and many others (Mk4)
faults.description: Mercedes has issued 22 recalls for the 2018-on Mk4. They include faulty crankshafts needing engine replacement, leaking turbochargers, loose rear axle bolts and faulty panoramic sunroofs. Check by VIN.
